reviews.text: Brought a friend's dog over, training prices seemed a bit high, I know of a few other places up north that are way cheaper, where animals are in a much nicer outdoor country setting.

I brought my overly anxious dog there with little expectation. Every trainer I tried before did not manage to connect with my dog. Karl worked magic with him. Not only did my dog transform into an obedient puppy (when he's not in his teenage crisis), the school is now one of the few places he feels totally safe! Karl even had various trainers work with him in order to grow his confidence. I will continue to bring my dog there for daily boarding, and I might even continue training sessions with Karl or any other employees of his that can work with him.

10/10 recommend (and I have done so to friends and coworkers)!

I had an uncontrollable miniature pinscher, would bark at anything or anyone, pull on the leash, I had a fear of him running away and not responding to my commands. After Karl's guidance and training my dog. Zeus is obedient, controlled and I can walk him full confidence!
The best place to make my dog ​​feel comfortable, especially when I notice that my dog ​​is tied up and loves the person who feeds him ❤️

Carl is a very great trainer my son got a French bulldog and we had really problems to get him to listen always doing his cells inside never on pad and I brought him at centre professionel canin and left him for 5 weeks and amazing results
I recommend this place anytime
Keep on the great work
Thank you

Thanks to Dino for the referral. I'm very happy with the service I received because my dog ​​is much more disciplined.
Thanks, Carl.

I brought my puppy when she was six months old. After a few weeks, she learned how to sit and lie down, but we also noticed that she did everything with a lot of aggression, which made her very anxious and aggressive towards other dogs. In conclusion, it's not a recommended environment.
Definitely recommend this training centre! Excellent results, competent staff, no cruelty, and first and foremost, I can now enjoy our well behaved dog!

This canine establishment is super competent! Compliments to Carl and his team for addressing and correcting all of our concerns with our 7 month old Malinois. He is transformed beyond belief! He is now calmer, super attentive, and super responsive to commands! I will add that he strikes an adorable “Prince pose” on command (see pic attached). As for the premises, and being super picky as I am, all is well maintained for a clean environment! Thank you and bravo Carl 👏🏼👏🏼👏🏼 🐾🐾🐾!

Exceptional service!!!
I recently had my dogs trained, and thanks to Karl, our Standard Poodle and our Corgi (who has quite a stubborn streak 😅), he's brought them to a level where we can now walk them off-leash, even when we encounter other dogs!

A huge thank you to Karl and the dog training center 👏🐾
— A grateful family

Worst place ever! They tell you to leave your dog behind so they can make more money off you, but the dog won't understand anything; it will become even more feral and stupid. Don't go there if you love your pet! Worst place ever!!!!!!!!!!

I came out of this place in disbeleif, not because of the dogs crualty i witnessed but how are people so irresponsable to leave their animal in a place like this without asking to visit .

Dogs were in terrible conditions, i feel sick, strong odor, starving, all of them barking like crazy

Traumatism for any dogs

We own a female German Shepherd who is anxious and reacts poorly to other dogs.

We consulted several dog trainers before being referred to the Professional Canine Center. They know the German Shepherd breed well, and it shows! Now, my dog ​​is no longer the boss of the house and she listens well. Thank you to the whole team for the excellent advice.
Since then, our dog regularly stays at the Center for boarding, and when she comes home, because they took the time to train her during her stay, she is incredibly well-behaved. Thank you for taking such good care of our beloved four-legged friends.

Best place in town to train your dog.
Great service and great people.
Grooming for my cat ❤️ A very warm welcome, very friendly and friendly. Always excellent service. I've been a customer for several years. Thank you on behalf of myself and my cat Wanapin.

I sent my 14 week old Rottweiler puppy to this board and train program, and I couldn’t be more grateful for the transformation. Before training, he was chewing and biting everything, including my fingers. He ate everything.. rocks, woods, grass etc.. and was full of uncontrollable puppy energy.

After six weeks, he came back a completely different dog, the best way possible.
He returned calm, well-mannered, and responsive. The biting and chewing stopped, and he now listens to commands so much better.
I can tell he was treated with structure, patience, and care throughout his stay.
I highly recommend this place to anyone who’s struggling with early puppy challenges or just wants a well behaved dog..
Thank you so much Karl, Erika and the rest of the team!

I highly recommend the training center. A few years ago,  I had my dog trained there and we were extremely happy with the results. People often ask us if he was trained and where, and they’re impressed! As for the groomer, Chanel, I was pleased with the grooming experience! We have a standard poodle and he got a really nice cut. The  coast was pretty good too!!

I brought my 10 week old pup for a training and Alex was awesome. Full of knowledge, tips and tricks! We finished the class way more confident. Good for training purposes.

However, my dog was not happy to stay there ever! He got anxiety whenever we brought him over and looked terrified. He came home at the last stay with a neck laceration,  that was the last straw!
Thank you Karl for the great work done with Lola! My dog ​​is much calmer now 👌 …

Great and friendly staff. Very knowledgeable!
Great grooming service and very affordable.

Erika and Karl are fantastic! We enrolled our puppy in their obedience classes, and it was the best decision we made. Erika's teaching style is engaging and positive, and Karl's expertise really shines through. They created a supportive environment where our dog thrived. We learned valuable techniques to manage our puppy's behavior, and make sure to have the best time with him. The obedience classes were worth every penny, and we highly recommend Erika and Karl to any dog owner!

I'm not usually one to complain or leave a bad review when I receive poor service, but this time I was traumatized. In seven years, I've never seen my dog ​​with a haircut like that. I asked for a simple trim: a light clipping to maintain the shape of his coat and remove the excess. They completely shaved him. Everyone knows you don't shave a long-haired Chihuahua... I didn't even recognize my dog ​​when I arrived. And on top of that, the haircut was poorly done. I'm truly shocked and traumatized.

Hello,
We adopted our handsome Australian Shepherd, James, who had a problem reacting to other dogs. We had consulted a dog trainer who came to our home, and she told us that there was nothing to be done except euthanasia. A friend referred us to the Professional Canine Center, and from the very first meeting, Karl and Erika told us that he was a workable dog. They didn't waste our time or money. After choosing the 6-week boarding option with intensive training, they haven't let us down. If there are any adjustments to be made with us and our handsome James, they are there for us.

We highly recommend the Professional Canine Center for the quality and dedication of the trainers, Karl and Erika.

Thank you both!
Isabelle, André, and our handsome James! xx

10/10, my dog ​​Kenza has changed in just one month thanks to this center.

I highly recommend it!
Thank you so much to the trainers!

I enrolled my pit bull (female, 5 years old) at the center and had classes with Karl, an excellent trainer.

My experience was fantastic. In addition to taking care of my dog ​​as if she were his own, Karl gave me relevant advice and was very patient with me.

I highly recommend the Salaberry Canine Professional Center and thank them for their work and the attention they gave us.

Incredible! We left our spoiled dog, Bailey, in Karl's care, and after just one training session, there were already remarkable results.

After a few sessions, there was a noticeable improvement.

And after a two-week session, a complete and positive difference!
Thank you, Karl! I definitely recommend him!
Good service, my dog ​​often goes to kennels.
I highly recommend him for dressage. Carl is professional and provides excellent post-training follow-up to ensure our complete satisfaction!
Truly professional, and there were already huge improvements from the very first training session! I highly recommend their services :) A big thank you to Karl!
Worst grooming service ever. My dog came home cut and bleeding
exelent

I loved my experience with this place. At first, I had a dog with a serious behavioral problem. I didn't know what to do and was about to give up, but I found this place and with time and patience, my family and I finally have the dog we had always dreamed of. Thank you to Carl and Alain :)
I left my dog ​​at a kennel, he came out with several injuries on his paws and also on his muzzle, it was hell for my dog.
